response.description:
Announcing the public preview of the
redesigned designer experience for Azure Logic Apps (Standard), a major update
that makes building, editing, and managing workflows faster and more intuitive. The new designer brings run history and workflow editing
closer together, allowing you to iterate and troubleshoot in one unified view.
It introduces enhanced run visualization options for easier debugging and
removes unnecessary clutter from the design-time experience, helping you focus
on what matters most, building and optimizing your workflows. A new Notes feature enhances collaboration and documentation
by letting you add sticky notes directly to your workflow canvas. You can use
notes to document logic, provide context for team members, or leave reminders
for future updates all within the designer itself. This redesigned experience is currently available as an
opt-in preview for Logic Apps (Standard) in the Azure portal, with more
improvements planned for future releases. Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Redesigned designer experience for Azure Logic Apps [Standard]
